_doc: EXP-S, one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis (SIMULATION_SPEC.md section 9.5). Every learner parameter with a non-null range in configs/learner.default.json is set to its low and high value, others at default. K1-K4 (PREREGISTRATION.md) are evaluated in every setting.
parameters: all learner parameters with a non-null range
holds_rule: seed-paired mean difference has the predicted sign and its 95% t-interval excludes 0
